name: A Fine Day For White Sybill
source:
A stat management visual novel, where you keep your health high and suspicion low. Get out of the city and don't let your old gang catch you.

[From [url=https://trisghost.itch.io/a-fine-day-for-white-sybill]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部需要管理数值的视觉小说。把健康值维持在高位，把怀疑值压低。逃出这座城市，别让你从前混过的帮派抓住。

［摘自[url=https://trisghost.itch.io/a-fine-day-for-white-sybill]itch.io[/url]］
